discussion_comments.comment_body: I think this is the more efficient way of indicating no change - unless the onChange() lambda was intended to be non-null for a reason.

Thanks — I looked into this and am keeping the strict filter. Sibling STT providers' models already carry `type: "audio"` / `subtype: "transcription"` (set by `getAllAudioModels`), so the current filter keeps them. Relaxing to `!m.type || (...)` would also admit chat entries, which have no `type` field, filling the STT model picker with the entire chat catalog — the exact noise this filter removes. Verified against the current data flow.
